context.person: A person using a clinic scheduling service
context.user_goal: Accept the reserved time or choose another available option.

product_state.preceding_state: A clinician became unavailable and the appointment was moved to a later time on the same day.
product_state.current_state: The original 9:00 AM appointment is canceled. A 2:30 PM appointment is reserved for the same day.
known_facts: The original 9:00 AM appointment is canceled.
A 2:30 PM appointment is reserved for the same day.
The visit format remains in person.
The person can accept, choose another time, or cancel without a fee.
forbidden_claims: The new time is already accepted.

current_content.message: There's an update. Open the app for more information.

challenge: Rewrite the transactional sms so the person can understand clinic appointment moved, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Open the reserved 2:30 PM appointment and accept it.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Open scheduling options for another time or cancellation.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The original appointment will not occur.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Accept the reserved time or choose another available option.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
